notes:
Solo-performer recovery for census_montco_philly.json and census_delco_chester_de.json (window 2025-01-01 to 2026-12-31). Every listing in the saved raw data was compared with all census_*.json rows for the same venue and date (case/punctuation-insensitive, leading 'The' ignored). Only one-person acts (own name or stage name) were kept, and only when the same venue listed a band that date (census or raw) or the venue is a festival or concert series. Venue names, towns and states are copied from the two census files.

Raw sources used. Montco: mc/amh.txt (Tixr list, Ardmore Music Hall) plus the readable Wayback captures mc/wb/ardmoremusichall.com_* (support acts on the 'with ...' lines); County Lines Magazine listings in census/cl.json for Bryn Mawr Twilight Concerts and Upper Merion Concerts Under the Stars (both concert series with 0 census rows); mc/ser/ff_perf.html (Philadelphia Folk Festival 2026, one row per day tag, as the census did); mc/ser/amblerfest_org_2026-music-fest_.html; mc/ser/abingtonartcenter_org_concert-series_.html; mc/sc_sitemap.xml (Steel City, year from lastmod as in the census); mc/wb/www.visitrivet.com_events__20260314101000.html; mc/jb_all.txt and mc/kfn_all.txt. Delco/Chester/DE: census/h118l.html (118 North site listing, Oct-Dec 2026); census/h_jameyshouseofmusic.com.html; census/kf.json; census/lt.json; census/tr_wbw_full.json; census/sep.json (Punjab Live); census/pdf/rt26.pdf (Rose Tree 2026); census/h_folkclub.org.html; County Lines rows (cl.json) for Anson B. Nixon, Eagleview, Media Twilight; the Queen event slug and the Kennett Winterfest venue note recorded in the census.

Read but nothing usable: Stray Dog Tavern (openers not named), Molly Maguire's, Stable 12 (no music), Iron Abbey (no music), Bistro on Bridge (DJ only), Well Crafted, Fergie's (band karaoke), Lansdale fests and First Fridays (bands and DJs only), Skippack pages (no acts), Lower Frederick, White's Road, Montgomery Twp and Lower Gwynedd (all bands), Colonial Theatre, Keswick, Uptown, Kennett Flash County Lines months, 2SP (solo Fridays with no band that night; Delcofest/Winterfest bills were duos and bands), Penns Woods (solo-only nights), Victory. Not readable: Ardmore snapshots marked 'Temporarily Offline'; The Queen event pages and JSON (Cloudflare); Songkick gigographies for 118 North 2025-2026, The Queen, Arden Gild Hall, Kelly's Logan House, Brickette and WaR3house3 were not saved, so their bill-mates could not be re-read; census/pdf/rt25.pdf is an HTML error page, not the 2025 Rose Tree schedule; Ladybug, Havertown Irish Festival and Wayne Music Festival lineups (the census notes say solo acts were left out) are not in the saved files.

Judgement calls. (1) Ardmore Music Hall dates in the census come from Tixr and run one day late for shows starting at 8 pm or later (UTC). Support acts are dated to the census/Tixr date of the same event so they join the headliner's row, and same-day pairings of separate events were checked against the true dates in the venue's own captures (e.g. Charlie Cunningham 2025-06-19, Maggie Rose 2026-10-03 and Mike Dawes 2026-10-22 were really alone with solo openers, so left out). (2) Featured guests or sit-ins inside a band's set ('ft.', 'featuring', all-star Unlimited Devotion guest lists, Big Fire feat. Leroy Hawkes, Jesse Loewy Band feat. Lonnie Shields) were left out; named openers and co-billed acts were kept. (3) Solo headliners the census already lists as bands (Paul Gilbert, Bill Callahan, Robyn Hitchcock, John Craigie, Matteo Mancuso, Fink) count as the band on that bill, per the brief. (4) Theatres where the census kept only regional acts (Colonial, Keswick, The Grand, The Queen) got solo rows only on dates with a census band; Johnny Brenda's and Kung Fu Necktie the same (their solo rows already exist in census_named/census_solo_philly, so nothing new was added there). (5) Lansdowne Folk Club is treated as a concert series (season series of folk concerts). (6) Upper Merion's 2026 River Roads Festival and the Molly Tuttle show were at Heuser Park, part of the same Concerts Under the Stars series; they are filed under the series venue with the park noted in billing. (7) Skipped as unclear one-person-or-band: Sam Stinson (Miller Park 2026-06-28), Khemist Mayfield, Jim E. Brown, Brian Quinn, Bluebird, Mike Miller Sings Again, Charlie Rutan (no day), Next of Kin's headliner Katie Pruitt (bill-mate unclear), Marc Broussard (opener Sway Wild unclear), DNR at 118 North. Children's acts (PFF Dulcimer Grove: Dave Fry, Lolly Hopwood; Rose Tree morning kids' shows), DJs, open mics, comedy and drag were skipped; postponed shows (Whitney 2026-04-14) were skipped. (8) Delco Donny (Kennett Winterfest 2026-02-28) comes from the census venue note that named him as the solo act left out; the article itself is not in the raw folder.
